items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I only knew him by name, because, you

ctx.x: Yes, oh, yes. There was a lot of, but not too much over there at the Sunset, because they had their regular band. Carroll Dickerson, Cal Dixon was over there and you couldn't sit in with that band and this -- if they knew you, if you were some big shot, musician why you could go and sit in, but they would never let -- allow me to sit in at that time.
The building that housed the Sunset Glazer was owned, I believe, by Joe Glazer's mother?
